result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M when Garman handles Sparkling data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings provision and is professionally drafted. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the stated playbook and is not necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation, so the redline is not strictly minimal.
